input.quote: 12.3 Additional Termination Rights by AbbVie. AbbVie may terminate this Agreement in its entirety, or on a country or other jurisdiction -by-country or other jurisdiction basis, for any or no reason, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Harpoon.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 gives us (AbbVie) an unrestricted termination-for-convenience right, in whole or on a country-by-country basis, "for any or no reason" on ninety (90) days' notice, and no early-termination fee or penalty attaches to that exit (Section 12.10.1 preserves only accrued rights, and Sections 12.7/12.8 provide for reversion rather than a fee). Harpoon's termination rights are limited to our uncured material breach (Section 12.2) and insolvency (Section 12.4) — it has no convenience right at all, which is better than both our preferred and fallback positions. The 90-day notice period sits at the outer edge of the fallback (60–90 days) rather than our preferred 30 days, and there is no express pro-rata refund mechanic (of limited relevance given the milestone/royalty payment structure); these are noted but not material deviations, so no redline is proposed.
